GRADUATE PROGRAMS
Rice University is home to the #22 Chemical Engineering Graduate Program in the nation.
Graduate Admissions
Request Information
Our graduate programs offer research topics in several areas of chemical engineering and related fields while retaining an atmosphere where students and faculty have extensive personal contact.
The Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering offers a Doctor of Philosophy (PhD), a Master of Science (MS, with thesis), and a non-thesis Master's (MChE) degree that is suitable for students and working professionals.

PhD Program
Our PhD program is primarily aimed at developing each student's ability to conduct independent creative scientific research. Our PhD curriculum provides a sound understanding of engineering fundamentals, a mastery of engineering tools, and clear goals of professional development.
Learn more about our PhD Program.
About the Program
Financial Support
Application FAQs
Masters of Chemical Engineering
The Masters of Chemical Engineering program in chemical engineering (McHE) offers a non-thesis professional degree intended to better prepare students for a career in the field of chemical engineering. The program empowers engineers with strong technical skills, along with elective coursework in business, management, communication, and leadership.
Learn more about the MChE program.
Master of Science Program
The Master of Science program is a thesis-based degree that seeks to prepare students in the field of chemical engineering. This program opens opportunities for new graduates in industries focused on energy, (petro) chemical, materials, biotechnology, and environment and safety. There is no financial assistance available for this program.
Learn more about our Master of Science program.
Living in Houston
Rice University's location in Houston helps provide faculty and students with endless opportunities for collaboration outside the campus. It is the center of the oil and gas industry, the home of the Texas Medical Center, and NASA’s Johnson Space Center is just down the road. Living in Houston means employment opportunities throughout the region, parks, professional sports teams, world-class dining, and other attractions make it a great place to call home.
Learn more about Life in Houston.
